purpose: Fuse Tarawa M4A2 and Bengal M3 Lee/Grant evidence into Japanese anti-armor development decisions without requiring Tarawa survivors to provide all technical detail.

GALVANIC.evidence_quality: High battlefield certainty that US medium tanks with strong armor/firepower are decisive locally; low-to-medium detailed technical reporting because the garrison is destroyed/isolated.
GALVANIC.message: Existing 37mm/light-tank weapons are inadequate; 47mm-class frontal reliability against US medium armor is doubtful.

BENGAL.date: 1943-12 first half, subject to reopened settlement
BENGAL.evidence_quality: Potentially HIGH because Japanese division/army staffs survive, battlefield can be revisited, prisoners/documents/wrecks may be examined, and communications to Burma Area Army/Tokyo remain.
BENGAL.message: Allied 75mm medium armor is no longer a remote European/African phenomenon; it is physically entering the India-Burma theater.

development_consequence_candidate.confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH if Bengal contact with Lee/Grant is confirmed in the reopened battle
likely_IJA_requirement: Do not abandon the Shinhoto/Chi-Ha family for China/South use.
Accelerate Chi-He production/acceptance for better crew/radio/armor system qualities.
Open an urgent 75mm-class stopgap medium-tank or mobile anti-tank requirement rather than waiting only for Chi-To.
Raise Ho-Ni / mobile 75mm AT reserve priority and issue tactical guidance for flank/ambush/mines against 30-ton Allied mediums.
development_consequence_candidate.important: The requirement is no longer 'counter Sherman specifically'. It becomes 'counter Allied 30-ton 75mm medium tanks now appearing in both Pacific amphibious and India-Burma theaters'.

technical_intelligence_gate.best_case: One recoverable/captured Lee/Grant or major components/document set allows measurement of armor, gun layout, radio, tracks, engine and internal arrangement.
technical_intelligence_gate.center: Detailed field reports plus inspection of at least one damaged/wrecked vehicle; enough to confirm armor/firepower class, not reproduce its technology.
technical_intelligence_gate.low_case: Only combat observation; still reinforces urgency but gives little engineering detail.
